# cozystack_foundationdb (Data Source)

Read an existing Cozystack FoundationDB cluster by name and namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cozystack_foundationdb" "fdb" {
  name      = "fdb"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) FoundationDB instance name.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_replacements` (Boolean) Whether automatic pod replacements are enabled.
- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version.
- `custom_parameters` (List of String) Custom parameters.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `namespace/name`.
- `image_type` (String) Container image deployment type.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `resources` (Attributes) Explicit CPU and memory per replica, when set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `resources_preset` (String) Sizing preset.
- `storage` (Attributes) Persistent storage configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String) CPU available to each replica.
- `memory` (String) Memory available to each replica.


<a id="nestedatt--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage`

Read-Only:

- `size` (String) Size of persistent volumes.
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass used to store the data.
